warnings: Second sheet of spread-footing details, continuing S-08/หน้า35 (which covers the three smaller sizes). These are the spread-footing alternate of the foundation — see S-02/หน้า29's 'pick one system' warning; the pile-footing equivalents for the same columns are F9 (=F1.30x1.30), F10 (=F1.40x1.40) and F12 (=F1.50x1.50) on S-11/S-12.

All three share the same pedestal note 'ตอม่อดูขยายเสา' pointing to the column table on S-13/หน้า40 — pedestal rebar is not repeated here. The two '0.20' dimensions flanking the pedestal on each detail are recorded in each element's note rather than as a member dimension: they measure outward from the pedestal faces, and no member edge is drawn at either end of them, so what exactly they set is not resolvable from this sheet alone (the column table gives the pedestal itself as 0.30x0.30 at footing level).

Bar-type convention used in this house's files: ø9มม and smaller are recorded as 'RB' (plain round), ø12มม and larger as 'DB' (deformed) — the drawing prints only 'ø' for both, so the type is inferred from Thai practice and the sizes involved, not read off the sheet.

'1ø9มม.รัดรอบ' (one Ø9 bar bound around the perimeter of the mat, drawn as the dashed rectangle at mid-depth) appears on every detail on this sheet and is recorded under additional_bars, not as part of the main mat.
Common to all three: bottom of footing 1.00m below ระดับดินเดิม ±0.00, on 0.10m คอนกรีตหยาบ 1:3:5 over 0.10m ทรายหยาบราดน้ำอัดแน่น. Recorded once here rather than repeated per element.
